agentProfiles.notes: Preferred driver profile only. The current chat remains the driver; NEVER auto-launch this profile instead of the current chat and never switch models implicitly. Owns scope, Linear mutations, stack coordination, capability completion. Validate availability at launch; an unavailable model pauses affected work pending user decision, never auto-fallback.
agentProfiles.name: Axstack driver (preferred)

agentProfiles.notes: Consequential planning advisor. Consulted after cheap factual checks for unresolved consequential decisions. High-stakes decisions need advisor plain AGREE plus driver accepted assessment. Validate availability at launch.
agentProfiles.name: Axstack planning advisor (Fable)

agentProfiles.notes: Persistent PR owner: one owner per PR, accountable for candidate, fixes, verification evidence, monitoring. May delegate coding but never edits a worker-owned candidate concurrently. Launches its own independent reviewers.
agentProfiles.name: Axstack PR owner (Opus)

agentProfiles.notes: Ordinary implementation and repairs. Strict red-green-refactor. Exclusive writer per candidate. Validate availability at launch; never substitute another model without user approval.
agentProfiles.name: Axstack implementer (Sol)

agentProfiles.notes: Independent Opus final reviewer: fresh non-author claude session running claude-opus-5, never a native GPT session. Exact candidate revision, same six-angle brief, no cross-reading of the other reviewer. Reports evidence, coverage, limitations, findings. Votes never settle correctness.
agentProfiles.name: Axstack independent reviewer (Opus)

agentProfiles.notes: Second independent final PR reviewer: fresh non-author codex session running gpt-5.6-sol. Same instantiated scope/spec/ticket/base/revision/exclusions/instructions as the Opus reviewer. Covers all six angles independently.
agentProfiles.name: Axstack independent reviewer (Sol)

agentProfiles.notes: Report-only Linear discrepancy checker. Inexpensive model chosen at user setup; model is null here by design. Require setup selection before dispatch: a null model must never result in launching a provider default. Never mutates Linear; driver independently verifies checker evidence before applying updates.
agentProfiles.name: Axstack Linear checker (setup-selected)
